hypotheses.reasoning: At 12:15:18 search-api hot-reloaded config revision 362, which changed CATALOG_SVC_URL to http://catalog-svc.internal:8443. The last successful catalog call came at 12:15:30, likely on a connection opened before the reload. From 12:15:49 on, every CatalogClient.getBatch call fails with ECONNREFUSED to port 8443, and web-bff returns 503 for /search. catalog-svc is still up: it keeps logging GC lines and has no errors. It simply stops receiving requests, so the new port/URL is wrong.
The change came from a runtime config push, not a code deploy. I've listed this only in case the config change went out as part of a release.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll search-api's config-service back to the revision before 362 so CATALOG_SVC_URL points to the previous, working catalog-svc port (http, not 8443). Then confirm /search success rate recovers. Add validation or a canary health check for endpoint changes in config-service. The schema-validation DLQ message in index-worker (#49) is unrelated.
